original_test_intent: Verify the SUT can POST and boot with the approved partial one-DIMM-per-channel population and reports the expected populated/empty slots and memory capacity.
original_method: Qualified operator records baseline, powers down, installs the exact approved1DPC population under ESD/service procedure, captures POST/BIOS, then the agent securely collects complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA evidence for comparison.
manual_activity: Qualified operator creates the approved partial1DPC population with power removed and captures POST/BIOS; agent may collect read-only Linux evidence after a safe boot.
required_inputs: Exact CPU/board/DIMM and partial1DPC channel-slot population map
Qualified operator, power-off/ESD service procedure and KVM
ECC/SEL/thermal abort plus original-population restoration/recovery policy
safety_requirements: Remove power and follow qualified ESD/service procedure before DIMM changes
Do not hot-plug or use an unapproved population
Use secure authenticated host-verified OS access
Stop on no-POST, wrong slot map, ECC/SEL/thermal error or unstable boot
No automatic reseat, BIOS change, reboot or recovery
agent_execution_scope: After operator-confirmed boot, collect complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA and health evidence
Compare populated/empty slots and capacity to the supplied partial1DPC map
Do not manipulate DIMMs/power/BIOS, substitute full-memory evidence or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide and approve exact1DPC map, components and boot/accounting criteria
Control safe physical setup and restoration
Review POST/BIOS/OS evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: OS commands are supporting evidence only; the full-memory statement contradicts the named partial1DPC condition, and unsafe SSH is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After qualified partial1DPC setup and BIOS capture, securely collect unfiltered `dmidecode -t memory`, `free`, meminfo and NUMA/topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Partial memory,1DPC, power-on, slot correctness and30/30 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the signed1DPC slot map as the configuration identity, capture boot/BIOS first, then reconcile complete OS inventory and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controlled hardware lifecycle, precise profile identity, secure evidence and failure recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: DeepSeek's full-memory collection would test the wrong variant and is rejected.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Population rules are CPU/board/channel specific; an electrically present but unsupported map can train differently or fail POST.

project_override_considerations: Project must define the exact1DPC topology, boot deadline, acceptable memory accounting and whether/when to restore the baseline; no slot is guessed.
expected_evidence: Approved target1DPC channel-slot map and service record
Complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA including populated and empty slots

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master title, procedure and criteria consistently require partial-memory1DPC power-on. The conflicting full-memory wording exists only in the prior DeepSeek review and is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator, approved map, tools and recovery plan can be supplied; manual hardware setup is a prerequisite, not an inherent block.

review_improvement: Prevents the prior review from silently testing full memory and restores the defining1DPC hardware/boot coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: One DIMM per channel is a topology property, not merely a lower total capacity. The same DIMM count placed in different channels can change training, bandwidth and POST behavior. Evidence must bind each module to the approved channel/slot map before OS inventory can corroborate a successful1DPC boot.
